entries.dialogueText: The grandfather clock in the tearoom of Brambleton Manor let out a series of deep, resonant chimes.

entries.dialogueText: I didn't care what she wanted to talk about. I was glad to get away from the capital and see my sister-in-law.

entries.dialogueText: Just as the clock's fifth chime sounded, the Queen of Rumburg materialized in the doorway, flanked by her attendants.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked down at the table in front..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked down at the table in front of me. A white porcelain plate and teacup were surrounded by roughly a drawer's worth of silverware.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I remembered my late wife lovingly..."
entries.dialogueText: I remembered my late wife lovingly instructing me on the particulars of Rumburgian high tea etiquette.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The outermost spoon was for spreadi..."
entries.dialogueText: The outermost spoon was for spreading jam on scones. The middle spoon was exclusively for stirring tea, while the inner spoon was for eating petits fours.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I left, Pabel had lovingly i..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I left, Pabel had lovingly instructed me on the particulars of Rumburgian high tea etiquette.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "No matter how many times I had high..."
entries.dialogueText: No matter how many times I had high tea in Rumburg, I still didn't have a clue which spoon to use for what.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please enlighten me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please enlighten me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can hazard a guess.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can hazard a guess."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry, Bea, but Intermerkopum appl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Bea, but Intermerkopum applications are closed at this time."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't make me laugh.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't make me laugh."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As if I'd want any part in that.""
entries.dialogueText: "As if I'd want any part in that."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Rizia has embarrassed itself on a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has embarrassed itself on a global scale. The entire Alliance of Nations agrees."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And rubbed salt in our wounds with..."
entries.dialogueText: "And rubbed salt in our wounds with the formation of your silly little regional alliance."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Little did I know my brother-in-la..."
entries.dialogueText: "Little did I know my brother-in-law would enthusiastically participate in his own cuckolding."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your formerly prodigious resources..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your formerly prodigious resources are dwindling, meaning that your usefulness to Rumburg is as well."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The reports I'm hearing of widespr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reports I'm hearing of widespread riots... most unbefitting of a once-great kingdom such as yours."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And furthermore--""
entries.dialogueText: "And furthermore--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our server returned with a silver t..."
entries.dialogueText: Our server returned with a silver tray of piping hot scones and a crystal ramekin of rose-hip jam.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the outer spoon and use..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the outer spoon and used it to spread jam on one of the scones.
entries.menuText: Spread the jam on your scone with the outer spoon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the middle spoon and us..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the middle spoon and used it to spread jam on one of the scones.
entries.menuText: Spread the jam on your scone with the middle spoon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the inner spoon and use..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the inner spoon and used it to spread jam on one of the scones.
entries.menuText: Spread the jam on your scone with the inner spoon.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And furthermore, you don't even kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "And furthermore, you don't even know the right way to put jam on a bloody scone!"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You remember your tea etiquette. V..."
entries.dialogueText: "You remember your tea etiquette. Very good."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But that is not enough to mend the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that is not enough to mend the rift between us, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The rift between us is too deep to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rift between us is too deep to be mended, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And I fear you have neither the me..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I fear you have neither the mettle nor the stomach for what's coming."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is coming, Your Excellency?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is coming, Your Excellency?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me guess. You're planning some..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me guess. You're planning something involving Sordland."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You have turned your back on your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have turned your back on your most loyal of trade partners...."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""With the formation of your silly l..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the formation of your silly little regional alliance, you have turned your back on your most loyal of trade partners."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have more mettle than you ever w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have more mettle than you ever will, Beatrice."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, you'll find out soon enough.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, you'll find out soon enough."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If I were, I would *never* tell a..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I were, I would *never* tell a Sord-lover like you."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't go around making ridiculous..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't go around making ridiculous accusations, Romus."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You wouldn't last a minute on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't last a minute on the Rumburgian throne."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You wouldn't last a minute on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't last a minute on the Rumburgian throne. Lena told me that herself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She drew herself upright and stared..."
entries.dialogueText: She drew herself upright and stared coldly at me.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I have spoken to the others. Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have spoken to the others. Your GRACE membership has been rescinded. Effective immediately."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia has outgrown the need for GR..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has outgrown the need for GRACE anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The age of monarchies is over. All..."
entries.dialogueText: "The age of monarchies is over. All of you will fall sooner or later."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I harbor no ill feelings towards y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I harbor no ill feelings towards your decision. You will always be family to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A natural development. Geopolitica..."
entries.dialogueText: "A natural development. Geopolitical relationships evolve over time, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you don't see Intermerkopum..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you don't see Intermerkopum as a threat. We can still work together in some capacity."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You'll never win your war without..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll never win your war without us. That much is certain."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Forget about it. You have made you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forget about it. You have made your priorities clear."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You are not my family, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are not my family, Your Majesty. My niece is. And you drove her away."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You are not my family, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are not my family, Your Majesty. My niece is. And you've left her to rot in Pales."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You are not my family, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are not my family, Your Majesty. My niece is. And you and that Azaro harlot are conspiring to steal her birthright."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If I happen to see you while visit..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I happen to see you while visiting Vina, I will be cordial. That's all I can promise."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You'll never hold your own against..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll never hold your own against the superpowers without us. That much is certain."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our server cleared the uneaten scon..."
entries.dialogueText: Our server cleared the uneaten scones from the table. Two of his colleagues delicately put down a towering etagere spilling over with petit fours.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the outer spoon and use..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the outer spoon and used it to eat one of the petit fours.
entries.menuText: Eat a petit four with the outer spoon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the middle spoon and us..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the middle spoon and used it to eat one of the petit fours.
entries.menuText: Eat a petit four with the middle spoon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the inner spoon and use..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the inner spoon and used it to eat one of the petit fours.
entries.menuText: Eat a petit four with the inner spoon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I raised my middle finger in the ai..."
entries.dialogueText: I raised my middle finger in the air and showed it to the Queen.
entries.menuText: Give Queen Beatrice the middle finger.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice recoiled in shock."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice recoiled in shock.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""So that's the way it is. After all..."
entries.dialogueText: "So that's the way it is. After all these years..."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Good luck to you and your Golden K..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck to you and your Golden Kingdom. You will need it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stood up and left in a huff."
entries.dialogueText: She stood up and left in a huff.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Now you make a mockery of our tea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now you make a mockery of our tea culture. I've had enough, King Romus."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Well. I'm glad we can at least enj..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. I'm glad we can at least enjoy our tea like civilized people."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You were just guessing, weren't yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were just guessing, weren't you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So have I.""
entries.dialogueText: "So have I."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why should it matter what spoon I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why should it matter what spoon I use? They all look the same."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was nice knowing you, Queen Bea..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was nice knowing you, Queen Beatrice."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Hrmph.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hrmph."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stood up and shook hands. As her..."
entries.dialogueText: We stood up and shook hands. As her attendants escorted me out of the room, I took one look back at the almost-full cup of tea on the table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I never liked it anyway."
entries.dialogueText: I never liked it anyway.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know full well which spoons to u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know full well which spoons to use, thank you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. Just because we've drifted..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. Just because we've drifted apart from Rumburg doesn't mean we've turned into barbarians."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was just guessing. I don't actua..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was just guessing. I don't actually care which spoon I use."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Civilized compared to whom?""
entries.dialogueText: "Civilized compared to whom?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As her attendants escorted me out o..."
entries.dialogueText: As her attendants escorted me out of the room, I took one look back at the almost-full cup of tea on the table.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Ha. I confess I'll miss your visit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. I confess I'll miss your visits."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stood up and shook hands. As her..."
entries.dialogueText: We stood up and shook hands. As her attendants escorted me out of the room, I took one look back at the half-full cup of tea on the table.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I will give you one guess.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will give you one guess."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""So how is that war of yours going?""
entries.dialogueText: "So how is that war of yours going?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Great. Swimmingly. We're on track..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. Swimmingly. We're on track to win the whole thing."

entries.dialogueText: "You remembered your tea etiquette. All is not completely lost."

entries.dialogueText: "Then again, perhaps my trust was misplaced. You don't even know the right way to put jam on a bloody scone."

entries.dialogueText: "Your faith in me is heartening, dear sister-in-law. I promise I will win this for Rizia and Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The fact that you remembered your..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fact that you remembered your tea etiquette bolsters my confidence even further."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want to beg. But is there..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to beg. But is there anything you can do for us?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Please, Beatrice. Can't Rumburg help a fellow monarchy out?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The situation is nowhere near as b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The situation is nowhere near as bad as you describe. I have everything under control."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It might look like we're doing wel..."
entries.dialogueText: "It might look like we're doing well, but our troops are suffering out there. Is there anything you can do to help us?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I know we're going to win. But a little extra insurance from Rumburg wouldn't hurt us."

entries.dialogueText: "I know you will."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid another military aid package is out of the question."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "We're going to need everything we've got for what's coming."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is coming, Your Excellency?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is coming, Your Excellency?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me guess. You're planning some..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me guess. You're planning something against Sordland."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "Oh, you'll find out soon enough."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If we were, would you run and tell..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we were, would you run and tell your new Sordish friends all about it?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Shh. They've got ears everywhere.""
entries.dialogueText: "Shh. They've got ears everywhere."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't like the sound of that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't like the sound of that."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't fret. It's nothing I would a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't fret. It's nothing I would ask your kingdom to involve itself in."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""All is peaceful in Rumburg so far...."
entries.dialogueText: "All is peaceful in Rumburg so far. But with neighbors like ours, we must be prepared for the worst."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""What I can offer you, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I can offer you, Your Majesty, is a chance for peace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want peace. I want the Gul..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want peace. I want the Gulf of Ales to run red with blood."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I like the sound of that. Tell me..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like the sound of that. Tell me more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have only ever wanted peace. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have only ever wanted peace. It is the Palesians who are the warmongerers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There will be no peace until Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "There will be no peace until Pales is ours."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Pales is a speck of dust compared..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales is a speck of dust compared to Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Say the word, and my kingdom will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Say the word, and my kingdom will step in and broker a ceasefire."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The casualties among Rizians and P..."
entries.dialogueText: "The casualties among Rizians and Palesians will only mount unless a third party intervenes. Rumburg can be that third party."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "Think about it. We could end this in a matter of days, without another drop of blood shed."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And without risking further damage..."
entries.dialogueText: "And without risking further damage to the Aureus gas field, of course."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""More importantly... we could final..."
entries.dialogueText: "More importantly... we could finally bring Vina home."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you do. But I kindly request that you hear me out anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the offer. But Rizia is perfectly capable of winning this war. Just give us time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg has too many conflicts of interest. You're far from a neutral third party."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I accept your offer, Queen Beatrice. It's time to end the Pales war."

entries.dialogueText: "And what would be in it for you, pray tell?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "Aside from the assurance that my darling niece will live to see another day?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The war is having a deleterious ef..."
entries.dialogueText: "The war is having a deleterious effect on Rizia's capabilities as a trade partner and GRACE member."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""There are greater conflicts loomin..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are greater conflicts looming than your territorial spat. I want Rizia by our side for them."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I would hate for your territorial..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would hate for your territorial spat to detract from your usefulness to us."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As you wish, King Romus. I will ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, King Romus. I will make the arrangements at once."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""To do this any other way would be..."
entries.dialogueText: "To do this any other way would be costly beyond belief. Trust me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My answer is no. Rizia will see th..."
entries.dialogueText: "My answer is no. Rizia will see this war through to the end."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you truly think Rumburg can bri..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you truly think Rumburg can bring a bloodless end to this conflict, then I accept your offer."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She paused as our server used a fin..."
entries.dialogueText: She paused as our server used a fine-bristled brush to sweep the scone crumbs off our table.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Let's hope you're better at waging..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope you're better at waging war than you are at conducting yourself at tea."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your tea conduct is atrocious, my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your tea conduct is atrocious, my dear. It's a good thing you have such civilized allies."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, dear. You were so close to get..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, dear. You were so close to getting it right."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It's a good thing you have such ci..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a good thing you have such civilized allies."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Well done. The fate of the world i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well done. The fate of the world is determined by the civilized, after all."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If that was a guess, it was a good..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that was a guess, it was a good one. We'll make a civilized king out of you yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Without etiquette, we are mere pri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without etiquette, we are mere primates."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I honestly don't give a damn. Tea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I honestly don't give a damn. Tea is for weaklings."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Says the king who can't end a war..."
entries.dialogueText: "Says the king who can't end a war without Mummy's help."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The next cup we drink together wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "The next cup we drink together will be in Pales."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "Hmph. The next time we meet, it had better be in Pales."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I most certainly hope so.""
entries.dialogueText: "I most certainly hope so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you once more for your assis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you once more for your assistance, Your Excellency. I will make it up to you one day."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am counting on it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am counting on it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We switched to small talk about our..."
entries.dialogueText: We switched to small talk about our kingdoms as we finished our tea and sweets.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We continued talking about the ceas..."
entries.dialogueText: We continued talking about the ceasefire arrangements as we finished our tea and sweets.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Pales war was finally going to..."
entries.dialogueText: The Pales war was finally going to end.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But I wondered if Rizia would ever..."
entries.dialogueText: But I wondered if Rizia would ever be the same.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I thought once more about the offer..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought once more about the offer I'd turned down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knew more lives would be lost bec..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew more lives would be lost because of my decision. But in the long run, it would be worth it.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Next time I'll have to invite the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Next time I'll have to invite the Duke of Pales here. Now that GRACE has accepted his application, he's one of us."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Of course, as you're soon to be th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, as you're soon to be the king of both Pales and Rizia, I suppose I can tell you anything I'd say to him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you once more for accepting..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you once more for accepting Pales' application. They will truly be a worthy addition to our ranks."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's high time you spoke to the Du..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's high time you spoke to the Duke. You two would get along fabulously."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As long as he takes care of our Vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as he takes care of our Vina."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As the kingdom responsible for bri..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the kingdom responsible for bringing the Palesians into the fold, I must insist you not make deals with them without my involvement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I own the rights to the Aureus gas..."
entries.dialogueText: "I own the rights to the Aureus gas field. Any contribution Pales can make is only incidental."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "I'll be the judge of that. But we're off to a promising start."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""A larger monarchical presence in S..."
entries.dialogueText: "A larger monarchical presence in South Merkopa is beneficial to us all. Not to mention that gas field."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Yes, don't worry. Rizia will alway..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, don't worry. Rizia will always be my kingdom's oldest and dearest ally."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I haven't forgotten about Rumburg'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't forgotten about Rumburg's wedding gift, by the way."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You tried to form a regional allia..."
entries.dialogueText: "You tried to form a regional alliance behind Rumburg's back. You cannot come crawling back to us just because it failed."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And for what? A sad, failed attemp..."
entries.dialogueText: "And for what? A sad, failed attempt at a regional alliance?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It is finally ready. Would you lik..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is finally ready. Would you like to see it?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without waiting for an answer, she..."
entries.dialogueText: Without waiting for an answer, she gestured to her attendants. One of them brought forth an oversized velvet-covered jewel case.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I lifted the lid. Inside was an orn..."
entries.dialogueText: I lifted the lid. Inside was an ornate ovoid creation, encrusted in the finest jewels.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's... an egg?""
entries.dialogueText: "It's... an egg?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, Bea. You shouldn't have.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, Bea. You shouldn't have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How much did this cost?""
entries.dialogueText: "How much did this cost?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure Vina will love it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure Vina will love it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That's an impolite question, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's an impolite question, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""A genuine Hattersley egg. One of o..."
entries.dialogueText: "A genuine Hattersley egg. One of only eight in existence -- but I'm sure you knew that."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It is a genuine Hattersley egg. On..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a genuine Hattersley egg. One of only eight in existence -- but I'm sure you knew that."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Symbolic of the new life my niece..."
entries.dialogueText: "Symbolic of the new life my niece and her husband will bring to the Rizian throne -- and the heirs they will produce, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Message received. The rulers of Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Message received. The rulers of Rizia will carry the Rumburgian bloodline forth through future generations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not put too much pressure on yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not put too much pressure on your niece to procreate. She's only 25."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And if it were up to you, you'd wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if it were up to you, you'd wait until she was 30? Her womb will turn to dust."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I detected a look of warning in her..."
entries.dialogueText: I detected a look of warning in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you. My house will treasure..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. My house will treasure it always."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You are most welcome.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are most welcome."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As is meant to be.""
entries.dialogueText: "As is meant to be."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Of course, the way things are goin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, the way things are going in Rizia at the moment, there may not be a throne for her heirs to sit on."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I would have invited Her Highness..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would have invited Her Highness for tea as well, but... you know."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our server returned with a silver t..."
entries.dialogueText: Our server returned with a silver tray of piping hot scones and a crystal ramekin of rose-hip jam.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the outer spoon and use..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the outer spoon and used it to spread jam on one of the scones.
entries.menuText: Spread the jam on your scone with the outer spoon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the middle spoon and us..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the middle spoon and used it to spread jam on one of the scones.
entries.menuText: Spread the jam on your scone with the middle spoon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the inner spoon and use..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the inner spoon and used it to spread jam on one of the scones.
entries.menuText: Spread the jam on your scone with the inner spoon.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Still struggling with your tea eti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still struggling with your tea etiquette, I see."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You remembered your tea etiquette...."
entries.dialogueText: "You remembered your tea etiquette. Very nice."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""In all seriousness, Your Majesty....."
entries.dialogueText: "In all seriousness, Your Majesty... I and the rest of GRACE have been observing the situation in Rizia with some worry."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I will assume you've appropriately..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will assume you've appropriately punished your Golden Guard for their oversight. I can only hope she is safe and sound."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I wanted to invite Her Highness as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted to invite Her Highness as well, but I didn't want to interrupt her married bliss. That first year is so special."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I wanted to invite Her Highness as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted to invite Her Highness as well, but she seems to be quite the career woman these days."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Of course, the way things are goin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, the way things are going in Rizia at the moment, perhaps she's better off abroad."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If she ever returns, I would urge..."
entries.dialogueText: "If she ever returns, I would urge you to go easier on her. She is your only child, after all..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I thought I detected a look of warn..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought I detected a look of warning in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I must tell you that I and the res..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must tell you that I and the rest of GRACE have been slightly concerned about the direction in which Rizia is heading."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What direction would that be?""
entries.dialogueText: "What direction would that be?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't play dumb.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't play dumb."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""In all seriousness, I am glad to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "In all seriousness, I am glad to see you are still sticking to the principles upon which GRACE was founded."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need for concern. I know exactl..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need for concern. I know exactly what I am doing."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That worries me even more.""
entries.dialogueText: "That worries me even more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Spoken like a true Dastnurist.""
entries.dialogueText: "Spoken like a true Dastnurist."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The last thing we need is another..."
entries.dialogueText: "The last thing we need is another Vendonesam on our hands."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The fires in your kingdom cannot b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fires in your kingdom cannot be extinguished so easily as those in Vendonesam."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hate to ask for more after you s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hate to ask for more after you so generously repaired the damage from the recent sabotage. But can Rumburg help us?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need for worry. I know exactly..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need for worry. I know exactly what I am doing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Another uprising was inevitable. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Another uprising was inevitable. If this is our time to go, then so be it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You had better.""
entries.dialogueText: "You had better."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am afraid not. Rumburg needs its..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am afraid not. Rumburg needs its full focus to deal with what's coming."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am afraid not. We have our finge..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am afraid not. We have our fingers in so many pies at the moment. But please do be careful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is coming, Your Excellency?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is coming, Your Excellency?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me guess. You're planning some..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me guess. You're planning something involving Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't like the sound of that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't like the sound of that."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, you'll find out soon enough.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, you'll find out soon enough."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If I were, I would never tell a So..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I were, I would never tell a Sord-lover like you."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Shh. They have ears everywhere.""
entries.dialogueText: "Shh. They have ears everywhere."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She laughed lightly."
entries.dialogueText: She laughed lightly.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Fret not. It's nothing I would ask..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fret not. It's nothing I would ask your kingdom to get involved in. Not directly, at least."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But we will need the full diplomat..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we will need the full diplomatic and economic support of our fellow GRACE members if we're to come out stronger on the other side."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your fatalistic attitude troubles..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your fatalistic attitude troubles me."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""My kingdom is going to need Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "My kingdom is going to need Rizia at full capacity for what's coming."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The rest of the world already hold..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rest of the world already holds certain prejudices towards monarchs. Your increasing zealotry is only confirming their suspicions."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Please, Romus! This is exactly wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Romus! This is exactly what I'm talking about."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""CSP and ATO are growing far too po..."
entries.dialogueText: "CSP and ATO are growing far too powerful. Any sign of instability is an opportunity for them to pounce."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Just like they have pounced on Cal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just like they have pounced on Caleqabiz..."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We can't have our attention drawn..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't have our attention drawn away by, say, Rizia and Wehlen fussing over Zille."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Which is why it's so important tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is why it's so important that you keep Wiktor Smolak from seizing Zille."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You are getting Zille back. That's..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are getting Zille back. That's an important step in the right direction."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree. Thanks to Rumburg, we hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. Thanks to Rumburg, we have the power to take the region back by force if the referendum goes south."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If the people of Zille want their..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the people of Zille want their region to return to Wehlen, I will not get in their way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will win the referendum. Of tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will win the referendum. Of that I have no doubt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Leave Zille to us. We will get it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Leave Zille to us. We will get it back, no matter what it takes."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But will Wehlen respect the result..."
entries.dialogueText: "But will Wehlen respect the results, when they did not even respect your father's treaty?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""When will you learn, Romus? What t..."
entries.dialogueText: "When will you learn, Romus? What the people want has nothing to do with what they need."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am counting on that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am counting on that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Two more servers delicately put dow..."
entries.dialogueText: Two more servers delicately put down a towering etagere spilling over with petit fours.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the outer spoon and use..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the outer spoon and used it to eat one of the petit fours.
entries.menuText: Eat a petit four with the outer spoon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the middle spoon and us..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the middle spoon and used it to eat one of the petit fours.
entries.menuText: Eat a petit four with the middle spoon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the inner spoon and use..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the inner spoon and used it to eat one of the petit fours.
entries.menuText: Eat a petit four with the inner spoon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then again, it requires us to be c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then again, it requires us to be close with Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And by the way... with or without..."
entries.dialogueText: "And by the way... with or without Zille, I am still expecting Rizia to repay its energy debt to us."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If there's one thing you should kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there's one thing you should know about Rumburg by now, it's that we have a very long memory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For some people, maybe.""
entries.dialogueText: "For some people, maybe."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, yes. I remember well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, yes. I remember well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Believe me, I know-- I mean, I rem..."
entries.dialogueText: "Believe me, I know-- I mean, I remember."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd be more worried about tearing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd be more worried about tearing her away from her new duties than her new husband."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right about that. She's bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right about that. She's been in seventh heaven since tying the knot."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Ah, yes. Quite the career woman, m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes. Quite the career woman, my niece."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She scrutinized me closely before d..."
entries.dialogueText: She scrutinized me closely before deciding to let the remark go.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Once the region is ours again, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once the region is ours again, we will be a stronger ally to Rumburg than ever before."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Interdependence between South Merk..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interdependence between South Merkopan nations is increasing. Rumburg will not be our suzerain forever."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Who said anything about a suzerain?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who said anything about a suzerain?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No matter what happens, I am grate..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter what happens, I am grateful to Rumburg for all its support throughout the years."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And I to you, dear brother-in-law.""
entries.dialogueText: "And I to you, dear brother-in-law."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am counting on it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am counting on it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""An ugly but necessary sacrifice.""
entries.dialogueText: "An ugly but necessary sacrifice."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Having said all that... I am still..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said all that... I am still expecting Rizia to repay its energy debt to us."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If there's one thing you should kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there's one thing you should know about Rumburg by now, it's that we have a very long memory."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, dear. Here I was thinking my s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, dear. Here I was thinking my sister had taught you well."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Nicely done. My sister must have t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nicely done. My sister must have taught you well."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Hm. Perhaps you learned something..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hm. Perhaps you learned something from my sister after all."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Honestly, GRACE ought to sanction..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, GRACE ought to sanction you for your breach of etiquette."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I jest, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "I jest, of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We continued talking about our king..."
entries.dialogueText: We continued talking about our kingdoms as we finished our tea and sweets.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Later, flying over the Sordish regi..."
entries.dialogueText: Later, flying over the Sordish region of Bergia in {RiziaDLCText.RoyalJet}, my mind flashed back to what the Queen had told me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Later, as our train passed through..."
entries.dialogueText: Later, as our train passed through the Sordish region of Bergia, my mind flashed back to what the Queen had told me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After seven years as king, was I pr..."
entries.dialogueText: After seven years as king, was I prepared for what lay ahead?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I flew home in {RiziaDLCText.Roy..."
entries.dialogueText: As I flew home in {RiziaDLCText.RoyalJet}, I saw Zille spread out beneath me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I flew home on yet another cramp..."
entries.dialogueText: As I flew home on yet another cramped commercial plane, I saw Zille spread out beneath me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soon, it would be ours again. And t..."
entries.dialogueText: Soon, it would be ours again. And then my reign could truly begin.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In only a few short weeks, its fate..."
entries.dialogueText: In only a few short weeks, its fate would be decided.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I appreciate our trade partnership..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate our trade partnership, I really do. But you have to know that you simply can't stick your spoon in two cakes at the same time."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your ambitions are admirable, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your ambitions are admirable, but you have to know that you simply cannot stick your spoon in two cakes at the same time. Speaking of which..."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You did hear the dreadful news, di..."
entries.dialogueText: "You did hear the dreadful news, didn't you? Sordland, in league with Dwight Walker and his merry band of freedom fanatics?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You did hear the dreadful news, di..."
entries.dialogueText: "You did hear the dreadful news, didn't you? Sordland, in league with Leon Malenyev and his troupe of revolutionary lunatics?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually, it's Leon Chavatangakwun..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, it's Leon Chavatangakwunua."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Isn't that all the more reason to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Isn't that all the more reason to retake Pales? It won't be long before Valgsland tries to snatch it back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""ATO is tightening its grip. Isn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "ATO is tightening its grip. Isn't that all the more reason to help us snatch Pales away from Lespia's influence?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're not going to try and fight..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not going to try and fight them, are you?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Rumburg will need every last penny..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg will need every last penny in our treasury and scrap in our arsenal to prepare for what's coming."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I wish I could say yes. But the ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could say yes. But the risk of escalation is too great."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, my, no. But we're stepping up..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, my, no. But we're stepping up our vigilance in case they are emboldened to invade."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Pales is too tiny for the CSP to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales is too tiny for the CSP to bother with. No, they've got their sights set on something bigger."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Whatever.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thought you were in league with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you were in league with Walker yourself, Your Excellency."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We trade with Arcasia, yes. But So..."
entries.dialogueText: "We trade with Arcasia, yes. But Sordland's presence in ATO will muck things up for everyone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""ATO? They're not so bad.""
entries.dialogueText: "ATO? They're not so bad."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't tell me they've gotten to yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't tell me they've gotten to you as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The CSP's not so bad. Valgsland is..."
entries.dialogueText: "The CSP's not so bad. Valgsland is even helping us in the war."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""With no ulterior motive whatsoever..."
entries.dialogueText: "With no ulterior motive whatsoever, I'm sure. Are you that naive?"

entries.title: Narrator: "With the invitation coming so soon..."
entries.dialogueText: With the invitation coming so soon after my declaration of support for Rizia's constitutional reforms, though, I had an inkling what she wanted to talk about.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sniffed."
entries.dialogueText: She sniffed.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your Majesty, when the Livingstons..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, when the Livingstons assented to intertwine our family tree with yours, we did so with the assumption that Rizia would remain a proud monarchy for generations to come."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you're speaking of our reforms,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're speaking of our reforms, I assure you I will still have the ultimate say in decisions. Everything will be the same as before."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "While making a mockery of the Toras dynasty. Of my niece's birthright!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Listen to me. These reforms are strictly cosmetic in nature. Nothing about our relationship needs to change."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "The royal family isn't going anywhere. We will still be influential figures, even if we do not directly make the laws."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have had it with your attitude,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have had it with your attitude, Your Excellency. It is time for Rizia to move on."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""For Dast's sake, can you be seriou..."
entries.dialogueText: "For Dast's sake, can you be serious for five seconds? We're talking about the future of your kingdom!"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Consider the repair of your energy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Consider the repair of your energy grid a parting gift. Rizia will have to clean up its own messes from now on."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""In fact, the assistance we gave yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "In fact, the assistance we gave you for your sabotage mess might be the last aid you get from Rumburg for a while."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After the help you gave us fixing..."
entries.dialogueText: "After the help you gave us fixing our damaged energy grid... I would not ask any more of you."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am not only offering for your sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not only offering for your sake."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""First you help us fix our energy g..."
entries.dialogueText: "First you help us fix our energy grid, now this? Rumburg is too kind."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It's but a trifle. Well, no, I sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's but a trifle. Well, no, I shouldn't speak so modestly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Reaching out to our neighbors was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reaching out to our neighbors was an experiment, not a threat. I fully intended to keep my partnership with my fellow monarchies intact."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can Rumburg help us?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can Rumburg help us?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I urge you to act in moderation. E..."
entries.dialogueText: "I urge you to act in moderation. Especially where your kingdom's religious differences are concerned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's nothing I can do about it...."
entries.dialogueText: "There's nothing I can do about it. This is the path that God has chosen for us."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""See, it's that sort of language th..."
entries.dialogueText: "See, it's that sort of language that worries me."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your Majesty, the rest of the worl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, the rest of the world already holds certain stereotypes about monarchs. Your religious zealotry is confirming their deepest fears."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am a simple man of faith, not a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am a simple man of faith, not a zealot."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Spoken like a true Dastnurist.""
entries.dialogueText: "Spoken like a true Dastnurist."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stereotype or not, I'm the one God..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stereotype or not, I'm the one God chose to rule Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia was on the verge of being to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia was on the verge of being torn asunder. In faith, the kingdom will finally find unity."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Is it 'unity' to promote only one..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is it 'unity' to promote only one branch of the Nurist faith, and shut out all others?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Come on, Romus. Drop the preacher..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Romus. Drop the preacher act for one minute."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""This is what I mean. Your continue..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is what I mean. Your continued disrespect for those of different faiths has gotten out of hand."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You are a king. One who has done h..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are a king. One who has done his best to promote one sole faith to the detriment of all others."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I cannot believe you would go so f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot believe you would go so far as to ban Dastnurist worship in your realm. Rumburg will not accept this."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your so-called 'Wruhec's Guardians..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your so-called 'Wruhec's Guardians' are a mere pretense to threaten and oppress the Dastnurists of your realm. Rumburg cannot accept this."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then I think it's about time we we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I think it's about time we went our separate ways."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I'm glad you agree. Rizia's mania..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you agree. Rizia's mania is ruining GRACE's reputation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your own sister came to believe th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your own sister came to believe that Wruhec was right in the end. You will as well."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Ha. She may have converted on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. She may have converted on the surface, but I'm certain my Lena never succumbed to your sham of a faith."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are the intolerant one if you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are the intolerant one if you do not believe my Wruhecist kingdom and your Dastnurist one can exist side by side."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We can coexist. But we cannot be p..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can coexist. But we cannot be partners. You have destroyed any bond we had."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But never mind that. My point is t..."
entries.dialogueText: "But never mind that. My point is that Rizia's mania is ruining GRACE's reputation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have an economic partnership. R..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have an economic partnership. Religion doesn't have to factor into it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It does when your intolerance send..."
entries.dialogueText: "It does when your intolerance sends Dastnurist refugees running towards our borders."
